event.canonical_title: Vincent Pastore, Star of 'The Sopranos,' Passes Away at 80
event.summary: Vincent Pastore, who portrayed Salvatore 'Big Pussy' Bonpensiero on HBO's 'The Sopranos,' has died at the age of 80. His passing was confirmed by his manager, who stated that he died at his home in The Bronx. Pastore was a prominent figure in the series, which aired from 1999 to 2007.
